title: spec: Rule 255 prose omits the RH3-only Routing-header policy all three implementations enforce
description: Codereview observation (pass 1, reviewer model) on the 1qs4 walk-set fix: the Rule 255 structural-validation prose now pins the TLV walk set {0,43,60} but does not spell out the stricter Routing-header policy that all three implementations enforce inside the walk: Routing headers MUST be uncompressed RPL source-routing type 3 (RFC 6554) with CmprI/CmprE/Pad zero, canonical ext_len (8+16n), and segments-left within the address count; type 0 is rejected (RFC 5095); any other routing type is malformed (python/src/lichen/schc/headers.py _validate_routing_headers :116-149, rust/lichen-schc/src/codec.rs :317-348, lichen/subsys/lichen/schc/schc_helpers.c :429-450). Pre-existing silence, not introduced by 1qs4. An implementer following only the prose could accept type-0 or compressed routing headers that every reference implementation rejects. Fix: add one normative sentence to the Rule 255 structural-validity list (or cross-reference the section that already normatively defines the RH3-only policy, if one exists — verify before writing).
